symptom: HTTP 504 Gateway Timeout during checkout spikes with db connection errors
root_cause: PostgreSQL connection pool maxed out at 50 connections due to unclosed idle sessions in payments worker
resolution: Increased pool limit to 250 in pgbouncer.ini and enabled connection recycling timeout idle_in_transaction_session_timeout=30s

symptom: HTTP 503 Service Unavailable immediately after deployment v2.4.1
root_cause: Missing JWT_SECRET environment variable in production Kubernetes ConfigMap values
resolution: Patched secret configuration in helm chart values-prod.yaml and rolled out restart of auth pods (kubectl rollout restart deployment auth-service)

symptom: HTTP 500 Internal Server Error & Redis OOM command rejected during flash sale
root_cause: Redis cache stampede: Un-cached product SKU queries flooded master Redis replica without probabilistic early expiration (XFetch)
resolution: Enabled Redis maxmemory-policy allkeys-lru, scaled Redis read-replicas from 2 to 6, and deployed probabilistic early re-computation cache wrapper

symptom: High consumer lag (50k+ events) and Kafka rebalance storm causing delayed order emails
root_cause: max.poll.interval.ms set too low (30s) while PDF generation batch takes 45s, causing broker to evict workers as dead nodes
resolution: Bumped max.poll.interval.ms to 300000ms (5 min) and offloaded PDF generation to an async Celery worker pool
